title: Recidivism
pdf_title: ## CHAPTER 9 ## RECIDIVISM The information on ‘Recidivism’ was available in respect of 1791702 offenders out of which 1624920 i.e. 90·7 percent were new offenders. The percentage of persons who were convicted once, twice and thrice or more was 6·8 percent, 1·7 percent and 0·8 percent respectively. 15·6 percent of the persons arrested for the offence of ‘Burglary’ were convicted in the past and this accounted for the highest percentage of Recidivism closely followed by ‘Dacoity’ (15·3 percent). The relevant statistics in respect of number of offenders and their percentage distribution of ‘Recidivism’ are presented in Tables 53 and 54.
